description.narrative: Hygenco Green Energies Private Limited (Hygenco or the Company), originally founded in October 2020 as Hygenco Private Limited (HPL), is a green industrial gases company that develops, designs, executes, and operates green hydrogen (GH) Projects (GH Project). The Company plans to develop a platform of GH Projects that will be fully or partially owned by Hygenco and associated renewable energy generation plants (RE Project). Hygenco will undertake such projects through project-specific SPVs.

The Project is expected to deliver significant benefits across multiple dimensions. By financing the expansion of the Companys green hydrogen (GH) platform, it will enhance access for downstream industries through a pioneering Green Hydrogen-as-a-Service (GHaaS) model offered under long-term contracts, providing a substantial cost advantage over grey hydrogen. This model will particularly benefit mid-size companies that lack the capital, technical expertise, and scalability to develop GH projects independently, enabling them to decarbonize without the burden of upfront investment. Currently, most hydrogen consumed in India is grey hydrogen, a major source of greenhouse gases. Therefore, the Project will help to cut CO2 emissions by replacing it with clean, green hydrogen. In addition, the Project is expected to create direct and indirect high-skilled jobs, contributing to local economic growth and workforce development in advanced clean energy technologies. Beyond the Project, IFC anticipates that the investment will promote sustainability and demonstrate a new, commercially viable pathway to decarbonization. It will also stimulate the development of new production ecosystems and value chains in the nascent green hydrogen sector through demonstration effects in the region, helping to accelerate market adoption and reduce barriers for future entrants.
